regimeSub: JGB selloff spills into global rates as BOJ hike bets surge; US consumer exhaustion pins Warsh.
themes: JGB selloff intensifies (Aug 18 Asahi) → BOJ Sept hike bets firm after Bessent nudge; USDJPY sticky at 159.5 as carry unwind risk rises
July NFP shed 23K jobs + retail sales crater → US growth tracking sub-1.5%; Warsh Sept hold locked in, hike cycle DOA despite 3.3% CPI
Global bond yields hit multi-decade highs (Aug 18 CNBC) → 10Y UST at 4.72%, 2s10s steepening to +53bp signals term premium repricing not growth optimism
KOSPI +5% Samsung/SK Hynix rally (Aug 17) fading → USDKRW at 1408 as BOK Deputy Yu hike signal (Aug 11) keeps KRW bid vs softer DXY at 99.6
